title: Add app-ads.txt for AdMob verification

requirements.text: Add an `app-ads.txt` file to `frontend/public/` containing the line `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0` so that AdMob can verify the application at the canonical public URL.
acceptanceCriteria: File `frontend/public/app-ads.txt` exists and is served at the app root URL (e.g., https://blockverse-9ge.caffeine.xyz/app-ads.txt)
File contains exactly: `google.com, pub-7936595519986908, DIRECT, f08c47fec0942fa0`
No other changes to existing files are required

constraints: Do not modify any backend files
Do not change any existing frontend logic or components
nonGoals: Changing the app name or branding
Any backend integration for ad verification
